text: This bar was lit. It wasn't a speakeasy though. There's an entrance directly at the front street. Speakeasies are supposed to be hidden and I was really wanted that experience! Other than that, the service and drinks were great! I left my card at the front and the bartender brought it to me and was really sweet about it. The drinks are only $7 at happy hour and they're cute and taste really good. Would definitely come back

The service here is terrible. I'm literally writing this while I'm waiting on my food. That's how terrible the service is. Who is the manager of this place? They need help seriously! The guy who rings up doesn't need to deal with people at all. He's a joke. He wouldn't give my husband his card back in his hand nor did he give me my change in my hand. It's not that hard to sell f*cking hotdogs. And why is the food taking so damn long?!!...
This was the first restaurant that I discovered When I moved to the area 2 years ago. Customer service is amazing !!! And the food even better

This is a truly authentic establishment with integrity and values their customers.   Sometimes, these reviews focus on the wrong thing.
The wonderful things you need to know is that their pizza is the real deal.  It is authentic Chicago pizza.  The thin crust is delicious.  The deep dish is so flavorful.   I ordered a Bacon and Garlic Deep dish.   Fabulous combo.  Even during this difficult time the owner took the time to call me about a small blip in my order.  Now, that is a place I definitely want to continue to give my business to.  Thank you Rosati's for listening and being here for your customers.  Thank you also for the delicious pizza!

Coronavirus doesn't stop the great happy hour deals at Metro. We miss Mike and Jackie but we're so happy to pick up a few bar starters for dinner last night. Great food, excellent service, better than home cooked.

We sat outside for dinner because the weather was great! A family friend took me here for tapas when I was in town and everything we ordered was delicious. We ordered the chips and dips as a starter. Then we ordered a few other dishes to share. Some of my favorites were the steak and bleu cheese and the brussel sprouts. Definitely recommend this spot for their variety of tapas and very unique and interesting combinations! You definitely don't feel like you're in Carmel, Indiana!

Covid -19 update: Can I tell you how impressed I was with Clesi's drive by/pickup system? Picture it, I was trying to get some crawfish  to bring to my parents on a busy Saturday afternoon. I didn't want to risk going into a crowded grocery store where people rarely follow social distancing or wait in line to go into a restaurant/store.

So a few weeks ago I drove up to Clesi's and they had a tent setup outside with the coolers of crawfish and employees who had hand sanitizer to offer me when I signed my name on their iPad, they had gloves on, etc. It was super easy and fast to get about 5lbs of crawfish! They were a little pricier than the grocery store or other seafood store but it was worth it bc I didn't even have to get out of my car or wait! I definitely plan on going back there again and getting more of their delicious crawfish! Btw, my parent's loved their crawfish too!

Oh and I want to mention that I found out they were open during this pandemic bc I saw them on the news!

Happy crawfish eating!

Do not go to Crackle Barrel St. Charles, dont waste your money. The last 6 months  this location is getting worse by the second. I really did enjoy going to St. Charles Crackle Barrel about a year ago now I don't plan on going back again.
The last 3 meatloaf meals the meatloaf is always burnt and they throw this sauce over the top like you don't know it's burnt. The turnip greens had a twig in them well it appear to be in the stick family, not eatable.  As in eating sticks is NOT in my daily calorie intake. The Dumplings use to be one of my favorites, but I got two serving of water down Dumplings. I may have had 3 water down  Dumplings floating around in some water.  Oh also, the food portion size have become so small, when I got my food I thought it was kids meal. Just terrible...

Iam very disappointed with service that we didn't get. We where seated waited over 15 mins waitresses didnt ask for refreshments neither knowledge that we where there. Not attentive we saw they seated the people came in they did ask for their drinks. We decided to leave so disappointed and we loving coming to oreganos.

I don't even know where to begin with writing this review. This is my second visit here this week and to say the least I'm very disappointed. I used to order lunch from here quite a bit and they've lost my patronage. Monday I ordered the broccoli cheddar soup which tasted fairly decent except for the fact it was overloaded on way too much salt. I also ordered a brownie for dessert which was clearly old because one bite and the whole thing crumbled in my hand. Now today I ordered lunch for my coworker and I, her chicken salad was absolutely perfect! My meal however was rather displeasing. Let me start off by saying I ordered their spaghetti and meatball special. For one it took them over 15 minutes to make the meal not only that but I clearly watched the person prepping my food microwave the spaghetti and added the sauce then they played it & sent it to the bar, only to have it sent back, where it was callously thrown into a carry out container, bagged up and handed to me. The young blonde girl working the front counter was not very personable at all. Also did I mention I got charged extra for some packets of Parmesan cheese like seriously. I will not be coming back to this establishment.

If I could give this place more stars, I would. This has been my favorite Chinese spot since I moved to Tampa! The food is always delicious and the portion size of one combo meal is enough for two people in my opinion. I highly recommend the sesame chicken or orange chicken combo

If you like your BBQ REALLY, REALLY LOUD, you'll love this place. I met a friend for lunch there and discovered very quickly that conversation is not on the menu at Edley's. After ordering at the counter, we sat a small table as far from the speakers blaring bluegrass as we could, but to no avail. I was literally sitting inches from my companion and we still had to lean in to each other, and speak very loudly, in order to be heard. 

Not fun.

I shouted (literally) at a server to get her attention and she came to our table and I shouted (not exaggerating) "The music is really loud. Can you turn it down a little?" To which she hilariously replied, "I'm sorry, what???"

So I had to stand up and ask her. She was very nice and agreed. She disappeared into the back and then avoided us for the rest of our time there. The volume was not turned down. My theory is that she asked about it and was told no.

In fact, both my lunch date and I SWEAR the music got louder a few minutes later.

I know some restaurants use loud music to encourage quick turnover of tables. If this is the case, it worked very well. We couldn't eat our food fast enough. We will NOT return.

The food (brisket) was very good, but not good enough to stop my ears from bleeding.

I love loud music--in a club. I want to be able to talk to my friends at lunch. It would also be nice if restaurant managers gave a sh*t when customers POLITELY complain about something.

Just sayin'.

Called in to make a pick up order tonight to try this place for the first time. We got the teriyaki plates and pork lumpia ... so good!! I'd never had lumpia before but now I'm going to have it all the time. The teriyaki sauce is amazing, can't wait to go back!

My family and I had dinner there the other night for the first time. We LOVED the lamb burgers, absolutely delicious! The chicken gnocchi was good, just not enough food for our son. Great atmosphere, we definitely be back!

This is my first time at this spot, and I'm impressed!! The seafood is phenomenal, and the drinks are nice and strong! The decor and ambiance is peaceful and welcoming. The owner is sweet, and the staff is friendly. It's only 10 minutes from my home!! This may have to be my new spot for seafood!! I'll be back for sure!!

LOVE this place! I've been twice & both times I got the "pick your cure" which allows you to make a custom burger. I get beef topped w/ provolone & beer gravy + tots & a side of beer gravy to dip em in. Sooooo good!
Great narrator/tour guide during the cruise!   Learned a lot and took some great photos!    Highly recommend

Used to be Lillys...used to be good.  I had a chicken cheese steak sandwich which was $9.95 on the menu.  The water asked me what I wanted on it I replied "everything". The chicken was some kind of ground chicken and the substance looked like mush.  The bill came and they charged me $14.95. Questioned price and waiter said it was because of all the extras on it.  My wife had fish and chips.  The fried fish was limp and soft as were both of our fries.  In short, never again.  Should have eaten on the street.  My mistake.

Very chill spot, the owner is  a good  guy and treats everyone like family, the Shrimp and grits is amazing and also They have a Hennessey Sauce that is down right addictive. its always a good vibe in here.

I absolutely LOVE this place. The decor is fantastic! If I lived in Tampa I (we) would be regulars. Sat at the bar and Carlos not only makes a perfect cocktail but will walk you through the menu. The oven backed goat cheese is delicious as is the Ahi Tuna which can be spicy or not. Drinks=heaven. Carlos makes a great old fashion old fashion!! But the best is tell him what you like and he will give you suggestions. I will tell you after a HORRIBLE day in Sarasota, this place turned my night around. If you're in Tamp DO NOT skip Anise!

A complete disaster.   Someone build a wall around their incompetent service.   What they lack in service, they make up for with horrible food. Please do both your patience and your stomach a favor and eat somewhere else.

Our class ordered pizza at Overton High School. The pizza was delivered to FRA (next door) the manager was called and he told us to go pick up the pizza next door and that's all he can do for us and that it's not his fault. MANAGERS NAME IS MO. Pizza sucked and was cold. Manager was rude. $70 worth of shit stupid pizza that sucked. ROMA YOU SUCK with your funky a55 attitude
The wait is long without a reservation and service is slow. I had the avocado toast but the hit at the table was def the cornbread! I'd go back just for that.

I still love Felipe's food, but throughout the pandemic, I've been pretty stressed about going there because of the staff. Every time I've been there, there have been multiple staff members who are wearing their masks only over their mouths, leaving their noses hanging out, or pulling their masks down completely when speaking. It makes me nervous that people who are prepping food aren't taking the necessary precautions to keep everyone safe.
Really good fresh food!  Had 2 protein bowl with double spicy tuna. Salad as base and this dish was so fresh and loved every bite!  Will DEFINITELY order again.

I guess I just had high expectations since I've been wanting to try this place out for the last few months. I'm a cheesesteak freak and should've just tried the cheesesteak and fries, but it's a southern diner, so I settled for the Wednesday daily special which was bourbon chicken and for my 2 sides I picked fried okra and Mac& cheese. Before I get into anything negative, I'll start off by saying that bourbon glaze(tastes like teriyaki) was so good you can put it on anything and make it taste good. Now the negative. That Mac & cheese was a big let down.  I tasted my husbands fried catfish and the turnip greens. Catfish was delicious but the turnips were straight out of a can. Service was excellent. Food came out hot. Can't really complain or brag. I do plan to come back for their cheesesteak. 

Social distancing was not practiced here

If you want to feel like you're experiencing part of early US history, please stay here. The service is exceptional, The lodging facilities are like none other and the restaurant and food are very good. A very relaxing place. I highly recommend for locals or especially business travelers who just need a break from the routine chain hotels

Just moved to Mount Holly from Montana and felt right at home at the prospectors dance club. Went 3 times in one week because it was the closest thing we could get to home. Today we spent 30 dollars to see a local band and as soon as they came on we were told we couldn't dance... at the country dance club. Needless to say we wont be going back. The bartenders are sweet and great, the dance floor is huge and great quality, but we will not be spending our money at a dance bar where management tells us we cant dance. Prospectors, loss of potential regulars.

The service was excellent. Huge menu, lots of options. I ordered Pad Thai with tofu. The portion size was huge. Noodles were great. The tofu was chewy. Couldn't eat them. We also ordered vegetarian gyoza, scallion pancake and summer roll for appetizers.  All delicious.

Best cheesesteak I have ever had....

So good I ordered another 4 to put I my luggage and bring home with me. Will go back for sure if I'm ever in the area.
The beet burger is soooo good! The pierogi is even better! Prices are on point, food is fresh and tastes great
Really fresh ingredients but a smaller selection of choices for breakfast. The service is very good and very attentive. I liked the coffee and was strong and full of flavor

Deep dish pizza in Indy- yes please! Usually the pizza takes about 30-45 minutes as they make it from scratch. Staff are helpful and generally friendly. They have other sides as well but the pizza generally fills you up.
Unforgettable awesome sandwiche! Change out the 12 grain for a sub roll and it's perfect

When I tell you that I have never felt more at home when I came to this place, it made you feel as if you were one of the owners yourself. They help with the menu, they help with drinks. And the service is better than chick-fil-a which to someone from New England where that is a premium is that service, it truly means a lot. The people at Skidders along with the atmosphere here is something I would not only bring my friends to but as well my family. Truly a place I would come again without a doubt.
Ordered through Grub Hub.  Food was pretty good.  Ample portion sizes.  Arrived in a reasonable amount of time.  It's a huge menu with Mexican and Italian fare.  All in all, slightly above average.

I ordered a pizza last night and it was supposed to arrive at 9:34 pm. My order was not delivered and was charged to my credit card! I called several times in the restaurant and nobody answered me! I want my money back!

Food is decent, little portions. Price is amusement 
park pricing. They need to try and quit selling the "clean food" slogan so they can maintain extreme pricing. They need to revamp prices and portions or they won't be around long.
I went to purchase one of their cookies after dinner,nothing fancy, just one of their large chocolate chip and carmel cookies.
The clerk told me it would be 4 dollars for one cookie! Uh forget it, you can keep it at that price!
Way overpriced and unsatisfying.
Love the food here, very tasty! Will continue to eat here, and would recommend to anyone. Very quick service, nice portion size, and good customer service.

This restaurant underwent an extensive renovation last summer and fall.The menu has also been changed and I can report the dining experience was outstanding. If you show up Monday evening it's half price for a bottle of wine which is quite a deal. All the food we had was spectacular very well done and very reasonable and there is a happy hour menu which is delicious and reasonably priced.

Still haven't really eaten here...I have a dietary restriction: can't eat egg yolk! So I requested that the frittata be made with egg whites only and assured them I was OK with an "up charge". This is NOT normally considered an unusual request but the Capello cook was unable to "throw away the egg yolks". So I ate at Peg's Eggs and had Huevos Rancheros -made with egg whites...for less money than Cafe Capello's fully-yoked frittata!

Came here for a group function so the menu was pre arranged. I went to the bar first and had a delicious lemon drop cocktail. Sarah was an attentive and talented bartender. I liked the way the light came into the bar during the day. 
I moved to our private room. The basket of bread came around with an addictive pizza bread. Our waiter Michael warned us! Speaking of our waiter, he had the patience of a saint and was great with the numerous kids in our group. He appeared immediately and he watched the table like a hawk- picking up empties and clearing constantly. He took care of our orders and everything came out as ordered.
We ordered three orders of fried calamari for the table. It was good but needed salt. 
The house salad was refreshing. It had various lettuce types, a tomatoe, and cheese. 
Of the five entree choices, I chose the branzino. The branzino was incredible. A slightly smoky flavor. Loved the broccoli rabe side too (substitute). Perfectly done- not overdone. The valet guy (redhead) was super friendly and found my car despite my missing ticket. 
This is a great place for a function. Despite two other functions, they don't miss a beat here.
The best pizza!  My daughter takes me there every time i come to visit here!  Needless to say i visit a lot!

Best place to get sushi in the New Orleans area by far. Very authentic feel to the place as well. The sushi tastes fresh and the menu is huge. It's not too fancy of a place by any means but the food is great and the service is incredible and that's really all that should matter.
By far one of the best Italian restaurants in South Phil. Food is out of this world, service is exceptional....A must go!! You will not be disappointed.

So good! We got the lamb korma and butter chicken and naan. The butter chicken is a little on the sweeter side, but flavorful still! The lamb in the korma was soft and tender- not chewy at all. I will say though, the restaurant could do a little better with managing time expectations. We booked online, and it said the food would be ready in 45 min. We arrived 45 min later, but were told to wait for 5 min, 10 min, 10 more min...there were a lot of people waiting. The food is worth the wait... but be prepared to wait.

This wingstop does not seem to have good professional leadership. It is usually dirty, especially the floor often being sticky or greasy. They often get the order wrong regardless of eat in or take out. They don't ever seem to have enough staff. Often you only see 1 or 2 workers. The cashier has to take phone orders so you may have to stand there waiting to place your order or even just picking up. The food itself is still good usually fresh in general. I don't go to this one to often anymore. It seems the owner pays no attention to this one.

Excellent, spicy and affordable. When ordering our server asked repeatedly about cheese and vegan options in a helpful manner and guided us to the best choices. Vegan and vegetarian friendly and oh so local!

My wife and I stopped in for dinner while visiting the area and were pleasantly surprised by the updated decor and the food. I started with the ginger salad and we shared some vegetable rolls. Nothing too different but then I had a bowl of wonton soup. First time I had some small vegetables in wonton soup but it was good. We shared an order of Pad Thai and glad we did because it was very large and had a full body of flavor. We both agreed we would have to stop in again on another visit to Brentwood.

Amazing service and amazing food! My boyfriend and I we're a little drunk after a long day on bourbon so I appreciate them being so hospitable. They treated us well. We had the ravioli and the muscles. I had a dirty martini. My boyfriend says it was the best meal he's ever had.

In a word, FANTASTIC!

It was my wife's birthday (I had informed them of this in our reservation)
and when we got there they set us up with a table outside with a panoramic view of downtown Nashville and had already placed a "Happy Birthday" card on the table for my wife that a bunch of the staff had signed. I had the brick chicken, my wife the filet with the black truffle mac and cheese (best mac I've every had), and the brussel sprouts. Everything we had and experienced was top notch.

My wife's filet in particular melted in your mouth (had to try it myself).

The experience ended with a candle lit desert with a hard chocolate in the top that said happy birthday on it.

In a nutshell, this is an experience you are going to pay for but in my opinion is worth every penny.
This was my first time going to chick FIL a. It lives up to the hype. Great food. Excellent customer service.
We did the cemetery tour. I have to say our tour guide Jay (what I remembered) is the best tour guide I have ever seen! He is so funny and informative, the best tour experience ever!!

I used to love this place. However, the bowls I ordered today were a little disappointing. The rice was hard and did not seem to be freshly cooked. The masago smelled a little turned. The cucumbers were soggy. I didn't finish the food. If the management would improve the quality a little, I will return. It is still the only poke restaurant near my house.
Wiping down tables so customers can find a clean place to sit would be nice.  Also, asked for a bread bowl for soup which I didn't get.

We had a birthday party for our good friend last week. Party of 10 sat outside. Food was 10/10, the food runners did a great job and the drink were amazing. but what made me write a review was our server Nate. He went above and beyond along with his assistant Halle. They did a great job explain and ordering the food for us. The seabass was to die for. Thanks so much for being open! Def be back again! Great job!

One of the most famous place near French Quarter. That was the first place I have visited for food in New Orleans. No specialty coffee, no hype interior or fancy food photos. Just a real American food. All fried and oily, toast instead of normal bread. But thats what you need if you hangover or hungry as a beast.

As lauded, Liberty Kitchen has an excellent Italian hoagie. They bread is the perfect balance of firm and still easily palatable. The meats are generous in portion and quality. 

The hoagie has a balsamic dressing that brings just enough oil and acid to the sandwich without overpowering it. And the cheese accents the meats, but isn't so Philly-bitter that it dominates the flavor profile.

Came in for Happy hour.  The happy hour menu is great.  We had the charcuterie board. Great! I had the Mai tai it was very strong and good.  Velvet had the happy hour Old fashion.  She said it was one of the best she ever had.  I had a couple of happy hour Vagabonds.  Very tasty.  Service by Dominique was excellent.

Will not be ordering again. I ordered yesterday for dinner. When the food got to me you could tell it wasn't fresh. The noodles and rice were dry and the beef in the beef n broccoli was so over cooked it snapped in half. After a few bites of everything just not tasting right I threw it away. 6 hours later started throwing up and been throwing up all night. Definitely got food poisoning from here.

Best Mexican in Pinellas!  Service was impeccable, food was delicious and drinks were delightful!  My husband had the grande steak burrito and the meat was well seasoned and very hearty.  I had the chicken quesadilla which was flavorful and accompanied by fresh guacamole and pick de gallo. This is our new favorite Mexican place!

We have eaten here 5-6 times on weekends since we moved to the area. 

The place is always clean when we go in and the food is really good. I get the fajitas and I must say they are the best I've had anywhere. Food is hot and fresh. Chips and salsa are notably good here. Now we go here about every week!
Best Gyro in Nashville. The food is fresh and authentic. The owner makes everything to order and it's well worth the wait. It's just delicious! I love this place.
Hands down the best Asian food in the area. Wonderful service and the freshest tasting food. It's always our default date place but now my kids love so we do takeout as well.
These donuts are great. Good value. Now I keep going back. I'll get a half dozen and they're gone within a day. And I live by myself.
Ordered a bagel with specialty cream cheese and just got a bagel. Add more cream cheese! Waste of money.

I've been here a million times and never been disappointed but this morning after going in for an açaí bowl I probably won't go back. The front case which is full of fruit (cut and uncut) was disgusting. There was a moldy cucumber and the lettuce was brown and wilted and none of the fruit looked fresh - definitely had been sitting there a few days. 
My açaí bowl also wasn't filled up as much as it usually is and paying $11 for a small bowl that's filled up half way isnt what I'm looking for.

Looks can be deceiving! Typical Chinese restaurant. We were not too impressed even though it is a popular place and people come in droves for a free glass of wine with dinner. First off it's very dark in there and they need to update it. Secondly, they only offer one type of egg roll. So if your vegan or don't eat pork, forget it as they don't have vegetable egg rolls! Thirdly, the breaded items are just that...all breading and very little meat. The dishes coming to the table do look good but once you dig in, you find that they are mostly all veggies and very little  meat. I ordered a chicken dish as my entree and found tiny pieces of chicken the size of pennies! Sorry but we were not impressed and won't be coming back. There are plenty of other Chinese places in the area we found much better than this place.

I'm from out of town so maybe I'm way off but honestly I don't get the hype. Sonoran dog and carne burrito were both bland. Bean burrito was even worse, honestly no flavor. 
Took 40 minutes as well...
First time  and excellent customer service! Menu is interesting and unique! Service was excellent and friendly.  And staff was friendly,  a rare find! Food was great! Our new place!

It was just as I remembered from years ago! I ordered the spaghetti with 2 meatballs, they gave me the awesome garlic bread to go! 
It was nice to see the family and the restaurant doing well! I met Tony's daughter Haley which she's decided to step up and take on the business! 
Maria was awesome and let me look around for my name on the ceiling, she was very informative as well as hey let's have a shot? I did have a tequila shot that had some type of coffee in it and was so smooth.
The spaghetti was just as I remembered from times past, I think these kids have it going on and will make it perfect as it has always been that way with Inez and Tony! 
I thank you Casale girl for the hospitality and memories! You've got a booming business, keep up the good work gurls! Thanks again and see you soon for another shot! Also I'll need that great Italian food fix when I come back! Spaghetti was top notch and the meatballs, absolute perfection!

This is a very beautiful coffee shop inside and out. The place lives up to expectations with friendly and cheerful staff and a good selection of affordable healthy menu options. The ambiance of the place is very comfy and was conveniently located. This is a  great place for any business meetings and dates as well. I highly recommend this coffee shop to everyone.
Bacquet's is one of my family's favorite local restaurants, the hospitality they display is unbeatable. Every single meal made here is perfect and if you haven't tried this place out yet, get on it!

I absolutely love this place! We are members ($20 a month) which gets you any bottle of wine per month, and it racks up if you skip a month without visiting. The butternut squash gnocchi is my favorite. The service is always pretty good too! The only down side is that you can only make reservations for up to 7 people, not a deal breaker though!

This was the best dining experience we've had in a LONG time! Took my daughter there for her birthday. The food was delicious and the service impeccable! Everything about the evening was fabulous and we really appreciated our server singing "Happy Birthday" in Korean. They were all so nice, and really on point with the wonderful service. For as little opportunities we have to go out, there's been so many disappointing experiences. This is truly an exception. THANK YOU Palaise de Jade!!

Elegance in historic hotel bar room with signature cocktails. Huey Long drank here. If it's good enough for the kingfish then it's good enough for me. Elaborate century old wooden bar enhances the glamour. It's a feel good oasis, and a good spot for a drink. Service is world class.
I really liked this place which is an Asian fusion restaurant. My dan dan noodles were excellent as was the service. The appetizers were also very good.

Ordered through GribHub.  First, Super China added additional charges claiming prices were wrong online.  Tried to explain they can't charge more than agreed to when ordered.  They blamed  GrubHub and said they add have to add up charges to GrubHub orders to cover cost of GrubHub delivery fees they have to pay.  If I don't want up charges added should call them directly and let their delivery person deliver it instead of GrubHub.  They shoved all food from a large order into one brown bag inside a plastic grocery bag.  GrubHub delivery driver asked them for a second bag to prevent problems and they said no.  She was very apologetic to us as she knew too much was jammed into the bag as did we.  Definitely an order that needed at least 2 bags!  The lid was partially open on large wonton soup and broth had spilled over everything in the bag.  Made a giant mess and ruined most items.  Even more than that mess, items were missing from the order too.  Total disaster!  The only good things about this experience were the delivery person from GrubHub and GrubHub customer service.  Will NEVER order from Super China again!

Came in for lunch to give glory days another try and definitely better than it was to go, only flaw we had was the Buffalo cauliflower was very tough at the middle and stem. I ate mostly the floret part but middle was undercooked, I told our server flavor was great but it needed 3 more minutes. this fish tacos were great, I love the little pieces of fish, and my sons chicken tender were delicious prefects cooked.
A no frills, family-owned restaurant. Ginza has great sushi and even better fried rice. Plus, the M&Ms at the end are an added treat!

Their serving time is super super quick while the food is still good. Their dishes also serve more meat compared to other Korean places I have been to. The only things I don't like about this place is their small parking space and their small side dishes. I am a big fan of Korean bibimbap, but I don't really like the bibimbap at Gogi(maybe it's just me:))

This driving is pretty fun with you can non-stop hitting the balls to the water. I have never found out how they get the balls back. But I think they might have something in the water, like a net to catch the ball and bring it back!

The customers purchase the balls by the vending machine and start to have fun. The customer service there is for bills change only. 

Parking is easy. The parking lots just behind the driving range. It is very close to the driving range and safe.

This place was absolutely fantastic. I went to celebrate my anniversary with hubby and was very pleased with the service and the food. The level of care taken by the staff and management to maintain cleanliness and infection control was super impressive. Upon arriving they took our temperatures, and during the meal the wait staff stayed at a distance, while being extremely helpful. I noticed one staff member frequently changing gloves appropriately and practicing great hygienic practices. The food was spectacular I got the Market steak with chimichurri, cooked to perfection and crusted with adobo. The thick cut steak fries were HUGE and crispy deliciousness. They bring out toasty sourdough prior to the meal which was yum. I'm dairy free (not allergen just preference) and the waiter was very knowledgeable about the menu and ingredients. I did, however, have to break my dairy free diet for the cinnamon bun which was by far the best cinnamon bun I've ever had. Definitely recommend; will definitely return.

Walked in here to grab breakfast on my way into the office this morning. Almost every table had people sitting at them, and it was 9:30 AM on a Wednesday!

Quickly ordered a meat lover's omelette with hash browns and rye toast. Added Swiss cheese, which in my opinion is a must for an omelette. 

The food arrived and it looked spectacular. Well cooked, well seasoned- no need to add anything else but I like a little Cholula with my eggs so that was it. I finished in record time and made it to my business meeting on time. 

Service was great, never wanted anything more and she did bring extra napkins so I'm sure it's not unusual for people to stuff their faces and need them.

All in all, I'm set for hours. Worth the stop- will definitely be back next time I'm in town!

Really stopped here for an excuse to go out on their second floor balcony over Frenchman Street, but stopped to get a bite to eat as well. Had a New York style hotdog (some of you may whine and say it is not a New York style hotdog because it is Vienna beef, but the toppings are New York style in my mind) with ketchup, onions, and sauerkraut. People I was with, who are New Yorkers, said I ordered it with too many toppings, but that's the Midwesterner in me who loves 50 zillion toppings on his comfort food.

In any case, the hot dog was pretty good and the service was pretty quick. Got the food In about 10-15 minutes and would happily go back. Balcony is one of the best in New Orleans by the way if you are into that type of thing!

Tried Addis Nola last night and loved it! Great food, great staff, and satisfying all our Ethiopian food cravings! We had the veggie platter, lamb tibs, and special kitfo. All were good and especially with Abita Amber, the closest to Ethiopian beer on the menu! Really loved the food and the laid back, welcoming vibes! Will definitely be back again.

Quick drive-thru service, accurate order, and the requested mustard packets were included. 

Napkins not included in a take-out order. Really?

Food: Worst Bar B que I've tasted since moving to Florida a year ago. Smell IS attractive on HWY 301, but food is over cooked, comes out of a cooler, not meat warmer. The sides are NOT fresh. The meat taste like someone poured a whole bottle of liquid smoke in the marinade. 

Service: HORRIBLE! The lil girl in the booty shorts was trained by the mean impersonal owner. His attitude sucks and so does hers. Doesn't speak or even thank you for coming by. And you charge for extra bbq sauce???...for BBQ!?!?  The way the "lil girl" handles the sides on the plate, is scary to say the least. Worse BBQ in town....hands down! Maybe if the service didn't suck, then you can pass some stars along the line...NAH....not here. Owner deserves every last negative star. 

To owner: You should be more personal to the ppl that keep your smoke shack alive!!!! And turn the A/C on for thr love of God....it's hot in Florida!
Super amazing customer service. The food was fire. And they have a great variety of food. a mom n pop type vibe. We definitely will be back !

Not the best I've visited. Disappointed actually. This was supposed to be a chipotle chicken avocado melt. For what I paid I would have hoped for some substance other than 2 slices of one inch bread with a few pieces of chicken and avocado. No flavor whatsoever either. Go to subway and pay half for twice as much
Best cannoli on the planet made fresh while you wait.  Love, love, love this place!!!

I've been in Eagle for 3 months now, and have eaten here more times than I can count. The food is great but the staff is even better. Such a friendly and great group of people, I love supporting this business!

Delicious carry out!
Lack of dinner planning led to a unusual Monday dinner out. Ordered Sapporo for delivery. 
Was delicious, almost as good as eating there. We had hibachi chicken, and two combos steak and chicken and filet and chicken. All cooked as requested. Special request for steamed rice on one order was done properly.
Came with soup and salad as would in restaurant.
Fried rice is always delicious and was also today.
Will do it again.
Great breakfast sandwich . Nice selection of hoagies and great wings . Very friendly and young staff

We ran into this food truck at Evil genius! We had very fresh guac and chips, delicious Korean beef and pork tacos and the service was excellent!!! We will definitely be return customers if we run into it again!!

Wonderful atmosphere and  amazing service from the moment we walked in the door till leaving. 
All of the servers were very friendly and knowledgeable. 
The hostess was very lovely as well. 
The food was absolutely amazing and we went ahead and had the special of the day and it was a great representation for our first time. 

They did an amazing job social distancing and following all safety regulations! 

You'll definitely be coming back!
We love Fireside Pizza Cafe. Some of our favorites include: Hummus, Fireside wings, pizza, pasta, selection of beers.
Even better than Robertas! The summer peach pizza is the best flavor of 'off the beaten path' flavor of pizzas that I've ever had. So good!
These are my favorite Great American Pub dishes from 2020. The food is really great and the management and staff are first class! See https://youtu.be/clxTrcHgnFs.

I am holding strong with the thought that Sea Dog stole a picture of my girls for their logo!! LOL. We decided to go to the Treasure Island location vs the one closer to us here in Clearwater just because wellllll its by the beach and they got that chill vibe going on. Friendly staff there giving us suggestions on what to try.

I don't normally take the time to write reviews unless the service was exceptionally great or I've had a bad experience that they've been given chances to correct and they failed. Plus, I am intentional about supporting black-owned businesses because well..I love and support my people but this was not okay. I've visited this place many times over the past few months because I love their fried wings and fish. This time however was 1 of 2 instances when the wings I ordered was undercooked. 

The first instance I called back after I got home and the cook (older guy) answered. I explained the problem, offered to send photos (because I couldn't return then), but he said it wasn't necessary. He apologized for the mistake, and offered to replace them during my next visit along with a 10% off any order on top of it. I accepted and redeemed the replacement a few days later. The 10% was never offered as agreed but still I didn't push the issue. 

Here we are again with the same issue (in photos) and again I called back and spoke with a MOD. I explained and she immediately apologizes but tells me she can only offer me a 10% off. I refused because after spending $20+ on lunch I couldn't eat, 10% was unacceptable and felt like a shrug of the shoulder. She tells me that she will take my name and number and would inform her boss so that she can call me to sort it out. After not receiving a call, I followed up again and I was told and I quote "my boss said that she fries the wings Kay's way

My absolute favorite restaurant in the city! I love this place so much, there are many vegan and omni options! I always bring my friends from out of town here, and I always recommend this place to people here for a conference of convention! You would not be disappointed!

I loved the atmosphere and menu at this place! I would highly recommend the bbq cauliflower. The pomegranate salad was pretty good, but small portion and not the greatest dressing. I wish I had gotten the French onion soup!

This is easily one of the best places to get poké! My roommate and I have been looking for a good place for a long time and since this one opened, we have been four times. Super friendly staff, delicious food, absolutely amazing!!!

I sat at the end of the bar just wanting to kill some time. Killed my time and my mood. The bar wasn't that full but the bartender seemed busy. He asked me what I wanted to drink and I asked him for a Yards. 6-8 minutes later he gave me a drink menu and 5 minutes after that he asked me what beer I'm having. I again said Yards. 5-6 minutes after that is when I actually received my beer. Fine he was busy, seemed overwhelmed. I quietly drink my beer and was right by the waiter station where they get drinks and overheard 2 waitresses basically bashing their customers. After that, I had enough, I asked for my check. 10 minutes later, he asked me if I needed another beer. I said no I'd like to close out. After 5 minutes he runs off into the restaurant, comes back and doesn't even look at me. I asked a kind waiter how much a beer was so I could just leave cash and go. He then asked the bartender, who then looked at me and figured out that I wanted my check. I paid and left and won't be back.
Great Breakfast; homemade biscuits and sausage gravy. Honey waffle, outside tables available!!
Love to support locally owned and operated businesses! I would recommend the baked chicken with rice and beans with extra sauce! Authentic flavors.

I will say the crab cakes are very good, but the miserable staff and the cheese steaks are terrible.

The owner is as miserable as his staff. Even when his wife asked him a question, he totally ignored him. The cheese steak was flavorless and dry and terrible. The fries were good. The staff was so miserable that my friend and I had to ask ourselves 
1. Why do they bother to come to work?
2. How does someone take a paycheck and not care about the customers of the company they work for?

THEN, to top off all that horrible experience, when I got the bill, it was higher than the menu prices. When I asked the so called waitress/cashier about why I was over charged, she said "it's right there on the board". The board was COVERED UP by another sign so no one could read the board that said, and I am paraphrasing a little - we are too cheap to print new menus but we are going to raise the already somewhat high prices but yet another dollar and then hide that from you., 

I used to patronize their one store quite a bit, but after this experience, I will never go back. Now I see why they had to close down their other 2 locations.

This place is adorable, perfect for making someone feel surrounded by the finer more feminine things- and not in a subtle way! The decor is white marble with pink flowery accents, and the desserts have sugar sparkles, golden, you name it. I brought my mom for her birthday, and she loved how "special" it felt.  We sat near the bakery window where you can watch the magic happen. Perfect for a special treat!

Peewee's is a small spot, with to-go food, but it has a lot to offer. I had heard this was the spot to get good, home-cooked food, so I had to see for myself.

After hearing all the raves, I was excited to step up to the window and place my order. This is a true take-out spot: there's an order window and a few chairs for your wait. I ordered the stuffed catfish, which is fish stuffed with crabmeat, crawfish and shrimp. On Armstrong's suggestion, I got the seafood rice as my side. Of course, one of Peewee's famous crab cakes was included.

The first thing I tried was the seafood rice, which was delicious! It had shrimp and other seasonings throughout and it was spiced well. I really could have eaten an entire plate of just rice. The catfish was mouth-watering and topped with a creamy thick sauce, with a bit of spice, that was teeming with crawfish. The dish that was rich, but not overpowering. The crab cake was incredibly good. Armstrong wasn't lying when he said that he packs them with 98% crab meat -- it was hearty and almost a meal within itself. I've paid way more for crab cakes that have had way less crab and Peewee's version is the best I've had.

The owner is planning to add a patio, so that you can stay and eat, so I'm going to visit again soon.

*Portions of this review was originally written, by me, for Very Local New Orleans. Read the full story here: https://nola.verylocal.com/dont-let-the-takeout-window-fool-you-peewees-crab-cakes-are-worth-the-wait/120167/

The food was spectacular and fresh.  It's a farm to table concept and truly everything is well thought out. 
The drinks were very yummy

Lousey...period...
We are native Philly-born folk...
We are accustomed to getting cheesesteaks as we order them even from the Chinese spots on every other corner...
So we had HIGH expectations of the renowned "Leo's" of DelCo...being well recommended...
Not! Mediocre at best...
Will not only not recommend, but will suggest against....
...go to Accu, Lebel, even Italian Kitchen (also of DelCo), but AVOID Leo's, their rep is overrated and they are clearly not ready for prime time...
....as a veteran of Jim's, Ishkabibbles, Max's, Abner's, Chubby's, Delassandro's, Mama's, Guie Louie's, and the like, these folk are no where close...will never return and I suggest you make the drive and spend your money in more worthwhile spots...
Signed,
One who knows better!

I googled "place to have breakfast in Indy" and this place came up. I'm in from out of town...I'll give it a try. 

That was the best dang omelette I've ever had!  The whole menu looks awesome too. 

The wait staff were great, provided recommendations on the menu. Unfortunately I'm on a no-carb diet, so most of the menu I cannot have. But dang, that custom omelette was good, and huge! 

The restaurant is easy to find, but parking is a little tough here in the big city. 

Give it a try!

Stopped in while visiting family in the area. Told our wait would be 25 minutes for a group of 4 - waited about 15 minutes. Once seated, service was an obvious problem.  Our server seemed to have difficulties from start to finish - taking our orders, checking back and bringing our check. Food runners brought food out hot.  I tried a Provençal  burger - delicious! If this sandwich description intrigues you, it does not disappoint.  I opted for fries on the side which were good - several in our party chose onion rings on the side - great choice! Large rings of onion which were served golden brown and crispy - don't miss your chance to try these. If service was better, a five Star rating would have been considered. Great place for burgers and more.

Kaylee the bartender was our server for happy hour. She was the best. Great employee. After I checked in on yelp we ordered the poke tacos, hummus and spicy tuna. Food was excellent. Drink specials worked out nice next we are headed to Left Bank books to met an author. The neighborhood is really cool. I bet nighttime is really fun
The Daily specials are great. Their Gyros are delicious and their Malibu buckets are wonderful. The staff is very friendly
Phenomenal food. Never been disappointed. Major down side the acoustics. If I want to catch up with friends we never come here as it's so loud we have to yell at each other :(

I was in the middle of ordering and this guy from Uber eats came in and ask for his order but they didn't have it ready and frantically were trying to get it done and disregarded EVERYONE in line. Then after getting their Uber eats order done they mixed up everyone's order and kept asking whose was whose and we also waited for teriyaki chicken for another 20mins after waiting
Horrible! Waited an hour for a plain pizza and fries they arrived ice cold!  Is been a while since I ordered from here for the same reason tried to give another chance but is a fail!
The best Chinese food in northern nevada!! Polite customer service and high quality ingredients in every dish. The Sweet and sour pork is best I have ever had!

There is this one nerdy server named Blaze. Blaze is so good at his job that we always come here for Blaze. Nobody else does as good as Blaze. All other servers are inadequate, as they know very little about bringing joy to their customers. We will name our dog or perhaps even our child after Blaze. Thank you for making America a place I want to eat at Blaze. Blaze needs a raise or perhaps a promotion.

Update: Please change name to O'Blazey
Update: Don't forget to tip Blaze

Ever hear the adage that there is no upper limit to the amount a business can spend on advertising?  Well, there's no upper limit to the amount a diner can spend at Chandler's.  Like the advertising adage, I'd also argue that increased spending at Chandler's also does increase the fun... to a point.  Their steaks are great.  That being said, I've tried the Japanese Kobe beef and hate to say it but it was not worth the extra cash.  I choose to believe that this is an attestation to the quality of their regular meat.  Their drinks are great and the appetizers are a mainstay (think tower of tuna with great avocado and crispy gaufrette) of our experience when we decide to splurge.  I've been to Chandler's a few times and most of them were great, so it might be a little unfair to report on my most recent experience as representative, but here it is:  We took our eldest son there for his high school graduation dinner only a few nights after they reopened and they were still working out the kinks of seating people, so we ended up on the short end of the stick for a while.  Now I'm not a demanding diner but I'll admit I was irritated when they tried to seat us at one of those small tables with the barstools.  Looking back, I think they were hoping to seat us there for our entire dinner which I definitely nixed.  So, they served us drinks while we waited and eventually got us to an actual table, being relatively professional about the whole thing. It sounds horrible to say but I think

Poor taste and poor service.

My wife and I came here because she has been craving pad Thai. 
After our visit she is still craving pad Thai. 
The portion sizes were huge but the taste was minimal.
The pad Thai was orange, it had no visible vegetables and herbs, and was sweet, not spicy as the menu indicates.
My wife did say the shrimp was cooked perfectly but that was the only positive thing she could say about the dish.

After 2 bites of the pad Thai my wife couldn't stomach anymore so we decided to speak to the waiter. We called for the waiter, literally, we had to call out across the restaurant because every time we needed something he was busy on his phone or watching Avengers on the TV. We expressed the problem to the waiter and asked if we could replace the meal with something different to which he agreed. After looking over the menu again my wife decided she didn't want anything more.

I had the beef with broccoli bento box lunch special. Aside from way too much brown sauce it was ok and a decent price.

We asked for the bill and the waiter brought out a takeaway box and the bill. Before I could say anything more he was gone again. When we finally got the waiter back I asked, "why we were being charged for something we didn't eat?" We were told "because you ordered it. We have to just dump it." To which I replied "yes, but my wife did not eat it. It made her sick to the stomach. We should not have to pay for something we didn't eat." I was then told he could charge hal

Another neighborhood favorite! I've been exploring all the sushi spots I can in the area and this one has made the top of my list. It's a bit pricey, but the quality and craftsmanship of the food puts it at five stars!! I've only eaten here once, but it was enough to know that I won't be actively searching for a fav sushi joint!

Let me start by saying that my breakfast selection and dining experience earned four stars. It's what happened at the end that tarnished the entire experience, and I'm being generous in giving two stars.

Waitress Kristina was very friendly and accommodating, and gave enough time to review the menu selection in making a decision.

I decided to try the Guava Crepes with Strawberries and topped with whipped cream.  Meantime enjoying a self-poured cup of half regular/half decaf coffee from a pot left at the table.

The crepes were served and looked as good as I imagined. Tasted delicious and I highly recommend them if you're looking to satisfy your sweet tooth.

As I mentioned, the dining experience earned four stars. As the bill was being reviewed, the crepes were billed $3 more. I checked the menu again, and it was not the same as what was on the bill. I pointed this out to Kristina, waitress, who said the menu price was wrong.  (One thing about me: don't do THAT!)  I said, "No, it's the price on the menu." To which she said she would check with the manager. 

The bill was adjusted, which was fine. Here's the kicker: the charge against the card is $600!  So, now THIS has to be corrected AND in the meantime is effecting making any needed purchases on the card.

I'm SURE it will be corrected, but Brunchies will have to earn more stars, IF there's a "next time".

We've  been coming here for 15 years. It was consistently great for a long time. We ate here once about 6 months ago and we noticed nothing we ordered was quite as good as usual. The meat was over cooked, the vegetables weren't fresh- in short everything was simply not as great as it had always been. We decided to give it another chance tonight and apparently things have really declined to the point of serving spoiled food. The seafood in the combination fried rice was clearly spoiled.  The rice was so old it had a mushy texture like it had been reheated with water way too many times. The chicken was tough and old. The cucumbers were soggy and rotted.
We spoke with Allan, identified as the manager, who apologized and offered  a refund but didn't seem  too surprised by our complaints.

The waitress was very slow despite us coming on a week night when the place was nearly empty. Then, when we got our food, it was alright! The chips, guacamole and drinks are really good! Then, we all got taco bowls and woke up with food poisoning in the middle of the night. Overpriced just to get sick.

A fun food fine for lunch or dinner. A well curated environment with an equally well designed menu and plate presentation. 
Friendly staff and attentive service.

I come here way too often as this is the best place for boba tea outside of Chinatown!! I've tried every boba tea worth trying in philly and this is my favorite. They also have hella crispy wings that are just delicious. The owners are extremely friendly and sweet, they make you feel like  part of the family. They also have a great gift card plan that's worth checking out. Definitely worth supporting during this tough time!!

I'm so lucky to live close to this pho restaurant. Whenever we can't decide where we want to go, this is our go to default because we know that the food will always be excellent. We usually start with the feied potstickers, even though we know that the pho is more than enough food for dinner. They are just too good to pass up. We have had the steak pho and the oxtail pho. Both delicious. I don't like well cooked meat and so I order my slices of meat on the side rather than in the soup. That way I can add it to the soup when im ready to eat it and csn let the soup cook it tp rare. The staff never complains about doing this for me and the steak slices are served on a separate plate, arranged attractively. My granddaught and I also order a fresh coconut to drink from, served cut open at the top with a straw inserted and a spoon so you can dig out the meat after you are done drinking. Out only problem with this place is the plastic chop sticks. The food slips right off them. While I applaud the conservation effort, we bring our own wooden chopsticks and avoid the battle of keeping the food on the sticks. These guys make some of the best pho we have ever eaten.

It's unfortunate because the food was REALLY good but the service was NOT. We made a last minute decision to go out to eat and weren't really dressed up. We got there and it took a bit of time to even have a server greet us (after being sat by a different server). He took our order and our food took FOREVER. I completely expect a little wait due to the disclosure on the front of the menu that food is made fresh but this was ridiculous. We ordered an appetizer, that we never got. They were not even packed when we got there but the other tables who came after us all got their food. 

Since it took so long and our young son was out of patience, so my husband took him outside. I asked for boxes and a check (we weren't even half way through our food). The server brought me both but just dropped the boxes off. I LITERALLY just watched them pack up the other tables food for them. I am NOT one to claim this but it was VERY obvious that because the other tables were dressed up a bit more (and older) the server was WAY more attentive. So, as I packed our food on my teeny table by myself , as the server walked off.

It's really unfortunate this was my first experience here and the service was just SO bad but the food was good...smh. I probably will not be back.

Great spot for mimosas! I always get eggs and grits for brunch here because they are too good to pass up. The staff is awesome and service is usually great. Sometimes the wait can be long but just because it's a hot brunch spot and worth the wait! Check it out the menu is great and has something for everyone.

Honestly , I wasn't as impressed as I thought I would be.  I've had some GREAT steakhouses to compare to!  the food at LongHorn Steakhouse is better in my opinion.  I got a filet (around $58 for just th steak) I got it butterflied and well done , it was burnt.  I get all of my steaks this way and they can still be super juicy. I got a 12 side of 2x truffle and cheese baked potato, it as well was just OK.  My husband got a NY strip (well done) it came out medium, sent it back and it came back still a little pink... he wasn't impressed either. The waiter was great and never missed a beat !
Ther service was really good and the food is the best we have had in the area.  So glad we decided to try it.  We will be back to explore more items on the menu.
A country style diner with mismatched decor. So comfy and warm with great service and a huge selection of comfort food!
Great place..... reminds me of a pizza park or back in 80's and early 90's.  Friendly service and the pizza is delicious.

Love this place they have amazing subs but they did not enforce the mask policy and even a woman behind the counter was not wearing a mask and she was handling food....very disappointing I definitely will not return to this location. They were very rushed and it just wasn't a good experience overall.

Hands-down the best donut holes I've ever had.  I'm not a big donut eater but I drive from Hendersonville to get the powdered donut holes and eat two dozen  of them by the time I get back home. The powdered donuts are the perfect size and texture.
The ribs.  Oh my!!!!! Falling off the bone, and  the sauce, delish.  I'll be back, and I mean real soon!!!!!!

Came here on a Saturday morning about 10 o'clock the crowd was just starting to flow in. Was able to get a nice seat on the patio with a great view and the customer service was on point seems like everyone was helpful and helping each other out. So I ordered the Mamosa flight which was delicious and if you're not careful they will creep up on you. The burrito was delicious and filling and the omelette was very tasty and the avocados fresh.

We had some food delivered via Uber Eats from Mahony's.  Fried Green Tomato BLT (awesome bacon, soft delicious bread); red beans and rice with sausage (amazing sausage, very good home made red beans); wedge salad (plentiful blue cheese, bacon) and shrimp po boy, good shrimp, fresh bread all around. 

Five of us at for $70, delivery included. 

Very good food. Would definitely recommend.

We had a brunch for the decades today at James Restaurant in honor of Rachel and Reno!

James is a place you've never been but ought to go.

We were greeted by bottomless mimosas with peach puréed juice and smiles from the James Wait Staff. When Racheno finally walked in ahead of schedule we felt that James was the perfect spot.

Lox and Prosciutto were the choices for the first portion. We were surprised to find that most of the group loved the lox and bagel, including myself! We had some first time rookies on the lox wagon, Train held no mercy on the plate. Jamie told me to write about how soft the bagels were, which was perfect for the sandwich.

We were all shocked when we found nothing but cake in the vault. The cake had zero flaws like Racheno. It was delicioso!

On the low, James is a top brunch spot in the city. Thanks for the bday!

wow, can I just saw 'wow'. We had a delightful and romantic birthday dinner at the Marc. The food was rich and flavorful. We ordered a salad and snails as apps and they were very tasty. The main entrees were pork belly and duck confit which were perfectly cooked. The service was also divine. We will come back again.

Was very dissappointed recently with this bakery.  This used to be a good bakery but we ordered a red velvet cake and it was NOT cream cheese frosting, so they cut a serious corner and for a $25 cake I expected better.  Also, the bigger point is not only was the person rude on the phone with ordering, they were equally as miserable when we picked up the cake. So we will be moving on from this bakery, there are much better in the area.

This oyster bar is always a favorite of mine. Fresh ingredients, abundance of flavor and super friendly service. We didn't sit at the oyster bar but opted for a table. We started with some sushi to start. One thing I love about this restaurant is their presentation. Sushi bars in Reno just don't use a lot of garnish. Or really any at all.  I'm accustomed to Los Angeles Sushi Bars where every plate has shredded  daikon, Japanese leafy greens, cucumber or other ornately cut veggies. Reno is so busy offering "all you can eat" to stuff your face, that they end up ignoring those who want a visual feast as well. To me, that's part of the sushi experience. Atlantis delivers on the visual. I'm willing to pay more for that. I'm about quality and not quantity. 

We ordered pan roasts and were pleased overall. Our sushi and pan roasts were not received as ordered. They adjusted our bill accordingly but our waitress should have done this without our having to ask. Everyone we encountered here was wonderful. 

On the low end, this terrace boasts a smoke free space, however, the stench of cigarettes is unavoidable wafting up from the Casino floor. It seems Atlantis could better address this unfortunate detail. At any rate, I highly recommend this restaurant unless you are ultra sensitive to the second hand smoke scenario.
My favorite is the Leadbetter with a fried egg added and a side of parmesan herb and truffle fries. Also tried the avocado cobb salad once and wasn't a fan but the burgers are definitely worth a try.
The light mild  chicken tenders were tasty. A tad spicy. The other guys in the group tried the spiciest. They said it was very hot but not completely unbearable. A nice small hole in the wall place.

I came to this place off a recommendation from my boyfriend. He suggested the hummus that comes with chicken. I didn't expect to see the chicken as big pieces within the hummus! It also came with a side of warm pita and a small thing of beets. 

I was skeptical that this would fill me, im so used to having hummus as just a side to supplement a dish. But boy, I was wrong. The hummus was so rich and heavy (in a good way) that I didn't find myself needing more. It was a nice quick, healthy lunch!
Horrible service no one speaks when you approach he window and mask are worn halfway!!!

Probably one of the worst Carrabbas I've ever ate at and the chain is one of my favorite places to eat at! I ate there Wednesday 5/22 around 11:00 I ordered my usual chicken bryan, grill asparagus with lentil soup! About 4 hours later I began to feel very ill, vomiting, diarrhea, nauseated and had a really bad headache. The next day same symptoms but felt very weak, my joints hurt I was still vomiting and had diarrhea. Here it is day three and I was up vomiting again last night and woke up to an excruciating headache that I couldn't get out of bed as soon as I woke up. It's 11:26 on Friday been having diarrhea off and on but still feel weak and tired. I would hope that this restaurant follows the national standards for food and safety! But looking back my lentil soup was only Luke warm and my chicken didn't taste like it normally does, it usually has sun dried tomato's but these tomato's didn't have the same taste, my chicken had a weird color and I should've sent it back, but being in a hurry and hungry I disregarded these things. I was only able to eat half of the chicken bryan! I just wanted to share my experience here hoping this doesn't happen to anyone else and I hope Carraba's looks into this and test those foods I ate to avoid making anyone else sick!
